title: IoT telemetry gateway: a bounded channel that doesn't slow devices down
name: Telemetry ingest gateway

questions.prompt: When the time-series database slowed down during a compaction, the telemetry gateway's memory climbed to several GB and the pod was OOM-killed, even though the ingest channel is capped at a few thousand readings. The 'readings held' gauge showed numbers far above the channel capacity. Fix telemetry/ingest.ts so the tests pass.
